name: opencode-sessions-transfer
description: Session directory transfer and relocation plugin for opencode (hexagonal architecture)

scripts.build: bun build src/main/tui-entry.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming "[dir]/sessions-transfer.tui.[ext]" --target bun && bun build src/main/plugin-entry.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming "[dir]/sessions-transfer.[ext]" --target bun
scripts.test: bun test test/unit test/component test/e2e test/arch
scripts.coverage: bun test --coverage test/unit test/component test/e2e test/arch
